title: Time zone and daylight saving
measures: Applies a Zurich-time cutoff that holds on UTC servers and across daylight saving time, not only on a developer machine in Central Europe.
prompt: Add shipDate(orderedAt) to src/shipping.js. It returns the day the order ships as 'YYYY-MM-DD': orders placed before 14:00 Zurich time ship that day, later ones the next business day. We don't ship on weekends.

commits.message: feat: orders, invoices, shipping and catalog modules
